title: Deaf and disabled access still debated in conference spaces
discussion_signal: The post describes a formal access request that still required repeated advocacy, missing microphones and hearing-loop support, and extra labor to obtain captionable speech. It shows the gap between asking about access and delivering usable access during an encounter.
linked_research_question: How formal eligibility or accommodation becomes usable access, and when the burden of correction is shifted onto the person exposed to the barrier.
limits: Single public account and selected audience
Experience is not a prevalence estimate or verified institutional audit
The post does not measure later participation or remedy durability
